Product Disclosure Certification Codes

Notes on Entering Certification Codes

* Refer to the certification code table

  • [1]-Korea Certification (KC Mark)
  • [2]-Electrical Appliance Safety Certification
  • [3]-KPS Safety Certification Mark
  • [4]-KPS Self-Regulatory Safety Confirmation Mark
  • [5]-KPS Child-Resistant Packaging Mark
  • [6]-KCC Certification
  • [7]-MIC Certification

* When there is one certification

  • Example: Shoplinker certification SEQ<**>certification number
  • -> 2<**>1_전기

* When there are two or more certifications

  • Example: Shoplinker certification SEQ<**>certification number<<>>..
  • -> 2<**>1_전기<<>>3<**>11_kps<<>>6<**>111_kcc
